court: In the High Court of Madras
respondents: State of Tamil Nadu, Rep. by its Principal Secretary to Government, School Education Department and Others .…. Respondents.
advocates: For Respondents: Mr. C. Munusamy Special Government Advocate for R1 to R4.
prayer: Prayer: Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India praying to issue a Writ of Mandamus, forbearing the Respondents from insisting for passing of Teacher Eligibility Test against the Petitioner to continue in service in the post of B.T. Assistant (English) in 5th Respondent School and consequently directing the Respondents to sanction annual increment and other service benefits in favour of the petitioner along with interest for delay in payment of service benefits, within a time frame to be fixed by this Court.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

M. Dhandapani, J.:— In view of the letter dated 23.07.2019 made by the learned counsel appearing for the writ petitioner to withdraw the petition, this Court has granted permission to withdraw the writ petition.

2. Accordingly, the writ petition is dismissed as withdrawn. However, there shall be no order as to costs. Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
